name: calibrated
status: candidate (T-104, 2026-11-18): opt-in only (scene key "timing": "calibrated"); the shared engine defaults stay the default until the owner approves

reach.source: reach to a contact: WT f012-f022 (10 f, no contact) plus the 2-4 f slow-in a contact needs; PB S4 lower 20 f

anticipation.source: WT f000-f012 chin hold; VISUAL_TARGET 5-10 f

hold.source: WT point hold f033-f050 (17 f), end hold f104-f120 (16 f), PB S3 f136-f150 (15 f)

shared_hold.source: PB S2 boat held with both hands f096-f111 (16 f); shared sheet f040-f070

place.source: PB S4 lower f151-f171 (20 f; report 24 f)

release.source: PB S4 release f172-f190; girl guide 12 f

return.source: PB S3 move f117-f135 (18 f); WT straighten f051-f104

reaction_delay.source: eyes first, then the hand; VISUAL_TARGET gaze leads a hand target by 2-5 f

beat_interval.source: VISUAL_TARGET overall tempo: one primary beat every 0.75-1.5 s

arm_lengths_per_frame.unit: arm lengths per frame (mean of an eased move)
arm_lengths_per_frame.source: VISUAL_TARGET peak hand speed 0.018-0.045 H/f (H about 1.1 m here), an eased move averages about half its peak: 0.01-0.025 m/f = 0.04-0.09 boy arm lengths per frame; the slow end, because handwork in the references is careful (PB S4 lower 20 f). In arm lengths, so a short (doll-sized) arm takes longer for the same distance: e907 girl (18 cm arm) needs >= 21 f to reach the cup without her forearm entering her vest (T-104 measure_t082 sweep: 17 f -3.1 mm, 20 f +1.0 mm and 25 deg elbow swing, 22 f +1.0 mm and 5 deg)

max_frames.source: primary action 10-24 f (VISUAL_TARGET) plus the slow-in of a contact; a reach of more than one arm length

personality: per character: content/personality/<id>.json tempo.beat_scale (every beat except holds) and tempo.hold_scale (hold, shared_hold)
